system_overview: homelab-backup-orchestrator is a scheduled encrypted backups across home servers to B2. It is built as a small focused system with Snapshot Agent at its core, supported by Encryption Layer (age) and Restore Verifier.

recommended_language.rationale: Rust fits the scheduled encrypted backups across home servers to B2 workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Snapshot Agent as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The scheduled encrypted backups across home servers to B2 hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Restore Verifier asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Host, Snapshot, RestoreTest must persist relationally
Components: Snapshot Agent, Encryption Layer (age), Restore Verifier
